calibration.method: on-site quick affine, 12 pts (seed 20261016), test 0.35/1.58/2.93 mm (g11 re-measured)

beta_today.definition: beta = 90 - angle(tool z, needle-plane normal); tool z rotated to cam by the polar rotation of the R6 affine; needle normal from the arc fit

conditions.A: wrist fixed at today's reference orientation (calib reference, deviation D2 replaces R4 q0); position-only closed loop. psi3 and beta recorded per placement as they come; no change of placement if it happens to be aligned
conditions.B: at 25 mm above p*: instrument roll (joint 3) to minimise psi3 (target <= 10 deg); wrist pitch unchanged
conditions.C: B, then wrist pitch (joint 4) in 10 deg steps in the beta-increasing direction until beta stops increasing (cap measured max 61.0 + 2 deg)

common_flow: approach 25 mm above p* (reference orientation) -> wrist per condition (at 25 mm) -> open jaw 0.8 rad -> manual template clicks (feature + grasp point) -> hover 10 mm above p* along n -> <= 3 stereo corrections -> straight descent 10 mm along -n to p* -> close -0.25 rad -> lift 10 mm along +n, hold 2 s -> release/return. Script scripts/r6_realrobot/r6_grasp.py
grasp_point: arc midpoint s = 0.5 of the stereo arc fit (s measured from the thread end)
tracking_and_correction: 10 frames, drop NCC<0.5, median, IQR; <5 valid frames -> tracking failure (no motion, outcome = 中止); stop if |e|<0.5 mm or (IQR>0.5 mm and the last two applied corrections < IQR); max 3 corrections; same for A/B/C
perception_checks: needle mask = clicked polyline band 5 px + darker than annulus by 18; r2_arc.fit on FS points (+0.5 mm ray offset); R 6-13 mm, arc 100-240 deg, rms <= 1.2 mm, >= 60 points; 2 frames: p* spread <= 1.0 mm, tangent/normal spread <= 10 deg; perception.json must be newer than the trial start and < 20 min old; laptop crash -> attempt void and restart
debug: up to 3 condition-C debug attempts on P0 (the needle as placed now), labelled debug, excluded from statistics

paired_rule: ECM not moved between placements (ECM is fixed for the round; scene change = needle re-placement by the user with the arm at calib base, outside the needle area). Needle must not move between conditions of one placement: checked by re-perceiving before every attempt (p* change > 1.5 mm or tangent change > 10 deg vs the first attempt of that placement = moved -> re-place and record)
success: needle lifted with the jaw 10 mm along +n and still held after 2 s (lifted_2s frames: needle off the pad and in the jaw; side video)

failure_categories.推开: needle pushed away by one jaw while closing
failure_categories.张开即碰: jaw touches the needle during descent (before closing)
failure_categories.未接触: after closing neither jaw touched the needle
failure_categories.滑脱: grasped but dropped during the lift
failure_categories.中止: safety rule or perception/tracking check failed
